source: Exact metadata claims from the recorded embedded SDK sales/shipping investigation. No model decisions replayed by production runtime.

claims.value: Pack existing allocated lines of a confirmed shipping order into one shipment, without buying postage or recording handoff.
Record actual physical handoff of a packed shipment, fulfill its allocated order lines, and post stock and accounting together. Carrier handoff requires a purchased label or exact tracking number.

Establish evidenced actual unit cost for existing uncosted stock without a physical receipt, quantity change, payment or supplier liability. Records immutable cost evidence and a balanced inventory valuation journal. Current purchase quotes alone are not historical cost evidence. Human approval is mandatory.

Confirmed accounting basis: opening_inventory for stock owned before accounting setup; previously_expensed for a purchase already recorded as an expense. Never infer either from a current purchase quote. Unrecorded/unpaid purchases require the supplier-invoice workflow.
Confirm an existing draft customer order and reserve available stock; report a real shortage rather than invent stock.
Set the measured weight and optional dimensions of one not-yet-shipped parcel, invalidating stale carrier quotes. Multi-parcel shipments require individual review.
